findings.summary: Completion reporting is premature: the handoff says the harness ran every task through gate evidence, feature flip, handoff and close-check, while F-1d-12 is passes:false with no gate evidence or task handoff; the plan ticks the results commit while the results are uncommitted. Limit the lifecycle claim to completed tasks and separate the functional checks from pending closure.

The skipped-check account names only odoo_sandbox.py info, while the unrun live gate set also contains env_check.py; the owner instructions omit E_AGENT_ODOO_API_KEY, without which env_check.py skips its authenticated Odoo checks.
